Karthik / Priyom — looked through the invoice and payment ledger. Notes: 

1) Duplicate charge: There was a retry from our payment pipeline that created a second line item for the temporary burst capacity on 2026-04-03. The ledger shows two invoice lines but only one successful capture; the second line should have been excluded.

2) VAT: VAT was applied by default because the customer record in our billing platform did not have the uploaded VAT waiver linked to the billing profile (the waiver was stored in a ticket but not added to the tax rules).

Proposed remediation: create a credit note for the duplicate line and issue a VAT correction credit for the affected lines. Finance can either: (a) post the credit to the next invoice, or (b) issue a standalone refund to the original payment method. For Novadia I recommend a standalone refund + credit note so their AP can close the month cleanly.

I’ll prepare the revised invoice and credit note if you confirm option (b). ETA: I can have docs ready by Mon 11 May and payment request to ops the same day.
